name: Am I Saved
overview: The question of salvation is answered clearly in Scripture by affirming that eternal life is a gift from God received through faith in Jesus Christ. God's love led Him to give His only Son so that whoever believes in Him will not perish but have everlasting life. Jesus Himself declares that He is the exclusive way to the Father, emphasizing that no one can come to God except through Him. The consequences of sin are death, but through Christ, believers receive the free gift of eternal life, assuring them of their salvation.
